proactivePolicy: Default off. Global and role authorization, quiet hours, frequency, daily and monthly budget limits are checked before network access. Proactive notifications contain no role or message text; requests contain no tools and share a process-wide model generation gate.
limitations: Static APK entry scan in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore files, SQLCipher upgrade, JobScheduler execution, notification delivery and live provider traffic require a connected device.
